new_points.title: A $2,000 Sweater Reveals Fashion’s True Cost

(Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: Warsh Sets the Tone for Fed’s Road Ahead

(Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: Can the US Defy Fiscal Gravity?
new_points.content: David Bianco of DWS says long-term Treasury yields and real rates have climbed to some of their highest levels in nearly 25 years, but he argues inflation is not the main driver. The bigger issues are structural: US deficits above 6% of GDP, a rising total debt-to-GDP ratio, and the need to fund more borrowing domestically as foreign demand becomes less reliable. The US still benefits from the dollar’s safe-haven status, but Robin Brooks of the Brookings Institution and former Dutch Finance Minister Sigrid Kaag warn that America’s fiscal path remains dangerous even if its “exorbitant privilege” gives policymakers more time before markets force discipline. (Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: $700 Cash Grants Transform Lives in Malawi

Bloomberg News Senior Africa Reporter Antony Sguazzin joins Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz on Bloomberg This Weekend and reports recipients are investing in businesses, livestock and home improvements, offering a test of whether large-scale direct cash transfers can provide a more efficient model for development aid. (Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: Russia Tests Ukraine and NATO With Escalation

new_points.title: Nepal Rescuers Race to Find Thousands Missing
new_points.content: Rescue and recovery operations are continuing in Nepal after a glacial collapse triggered catastrophic flooding near the border with China, killing more than 600 people and leaving thousands missing. (Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: By The Way: Headlines You Should See

new_points.title: Iran War Exposes Limits of US Military Endurance

(Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: Three Finance Ministers on Avoiding Debt Crises
new_points.content: US public debt just crossed $40 trillion, but the country is hardly the only one facing fiscal troubles. Nations around the world took on record debt during Covid, and many have struggled to bring spending back under control. Chrystia Freeland, who faced this problem herself as Canada's Finance Minister, speaks with former Dutch Finance Minister Sigrid Kaag and former German Finance Minister Christian Lindner about why fiscal discipline is so politically difficult and what the rest of the world can learn before markets force the issue. (Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: Warsh Says Fed Must Act if Inflation Stays High

(Source: Bloomberg)
